title: DECISION: MAX_NEWSGROUPS cap prevents crosspost DoS
description: validation.rs defines MAX_NEWSGROUPS = 100 and rejects any article with more Newsgroups entries than that limit. Without this cap, a malicious peer can send an article crossposted to thousands of fabricated group names; the transit pipeline performs one group-log append per name, creating a DoS multiplier. The constant is named and documented as an explicit DoS countermeasure, making the intent clear for future reviewers. The boundary is tested at exactly MAX_NEWSGROUPS (accepted) and MAX_NEWSGROUPS+1 (rejected).
